items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 August 2026 7:38am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 14 August 2026 at 7:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Weak cold front will move eastwards across our area today, followed by a ridge of high pressure.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, veering North or Northwest 4 occasionally 5 later this morning or early afternoon. Little change thereafter, although locally becoming Variable 2 or 3 in the southwest of the area for a time.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight to moderate.


##Weather##

Risk of patchy light rain, then generally fair from later this morning or early afternoon onwards.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in places this morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 occasionally 5, decreasing Northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow morning. Backing West 2 or 3 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight to moderate, falling smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
